About us

A business-first perspective on payments.

BLACK DUCK is focused on payment services for companies operating online and internationally. We help businesses explore payment options that fit their activities, customers, markets, and existing infrastructure.

Every business has its own payment requirements. An online retailer accepting customer payments faces different challenges from a company managing international supplier transfers, processing card transactions, or operating across several currencies.

We bring a practical perspective to payments, starting with how the business actually operates. From there, we help identify suitable payment flows, processing options, and connections that support everyday operations and future growth.

Discover Black Duck

Our services

Supporting the way businesses move money.

BLACK DUCK provides payment services across different stages of the transaction lifecycle — from accepting a customer payment to processing the transaction, moving funds internationally, and paying partners or suppliers.

Payment acceptance solutions for websites, applications, and other digital environments. We help businesses establish online payment flows that fit their customer journey, operating markets, currencies, and existing technical setup.

Card payment solutions for businesses selling products and services online. BLACK DUCK helps companies connect card acceptance with the processing and payment infrastructure required to handle transactions across digital checkout environments.

Payment processing connects customer payments with the infrastructure responsible for authorization, transaction handling, and confirmation. We help businesses explore processing arrangements suited to their payment volumes, markets, currencies, and operational requirements.

Payment services for outgoing transfers to partners, suppliers, contractors, and other business recipients. We help companies structure payout flows around payment destinations, currencies, transaction frequency, and the way funds move through the business.

Solutions for businesses receiving and sending money internationally. BLACK DUCK helps companies manage payment activity across different currencies and markets while supporting relationships with international customers, partners, and suppliers.

Payment links provide businesses with another way to initiate online transactions without relying exclusively on a traditional website checkout. They can support flexible payment journeys across sales, service, and digital communication channels.

Payment infrastructure

The systems behind every payment.

A payment depends on more than the checkout itself. Gateways, processing providers, banking infrastructure, routing, and transaction responses all need to work together. BLACK DUCK helps businesses connect these elements into one payment environment built around the way they operate.

Our approach

Payment solutions start with how your business works.

Different businesses require different payment setups. BLACK DUCK starts with the operating model behind the transactions — who is paying, how payments are initiated, where the business operates, which currencies are involved, and where funds need to move next.

Step 01

Map the payment flow

We look at the business model, customer journey, transaction requirements, markets, and existing payment environment.

Step 02

Identify the right components

Online payments, card acceptance, processing, gateway connectivity, payouts, and cross-border solutions can be considered as parts of one wider payment structure.

Step 03

Connect the environment

The final setup is shaped around the company’s operational requirements and existing technical infrastructure, creating connections that make sense for the way the business works.
